text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly – even a 30-minute walk each day makes a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours, so you feel fresh and full of energy. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by spending time with family and friends and enjoying hobbies. Small daily habits lead to a healthier, happier life.
